question: Should default `openclaw doctor --lint` omit the legacy state, session transcript/snapshot, and skills readiness checks while keeping them available through `--all` or `--only`?
rationale: The code and audit can prove selection mechanics, but they cannot choose the default diagnostic noise versus discoverability tradeoff for existing automation or bless the public SDK contract wording.

options.title: Accept the narrower default profile
options.body: Keep these checks explicit-only and rely on the audit/docs to steer users toward `--all` or `--only` for the full inventory.

options.title: Keep selected checks default-enabled
options.body: Restore any check family maintainers still want in default lint, then update the audit expectations and docs to match.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrower default profile
recommendation.body: Keep these checks explicit-only and rely on the audit/docs to steer users toward `--all` or `--only` for the full inventory.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and top-level history make this the best available maintainer-side routing candidate for the default-profile policy choice.
